what_works: The massive 999px corner radius creates a soft, pill-shaped aesthetic for the modal, defining a modern and fluid visual language.
Clear visual hierarchy is established through the use of a distinct blue primary color for interactive elements (buttons and links) against a neutral white background.
Ample white space separates the modal from the underlying content, ensuring the call-to-action remains the focal point without distraction.
The use of a variable sans-serif font (InterVariable) provides typographic flexibility while maintaining a clean, neutral type mood.
Standardized iconography and spacing (1px, 2px, 4px, 5px) create a consistent and predictable interaction model across the interface.
